I am building a life that fulfills me.
I focus on my well-being.

My worth doesn't depend on whether I was chosen or not.

I deserve peace and joy.
I don't stay in the past; the present awaits me.
There is life after this loss.
My heart is healing, even if I don't notice.
I smile a little more each week.
I celebrate my small victories.
Today I did something for myself and that counts.
I grant myself quiet days.
I am getting to know myself again.
I am free to write my next story.
This stage is preparing me for something good.
My future is wide and full of possibilities.
I enjoy my own company.
I learn to take care of my heart.
I don't punish myself for missing them.
I can remember with affection without wanting to go back.
I appreciate what I learned in that relationship.
I no longer carry what wasn't mine.
I stop looking for signs where there are none.
I set limits on contact if it hurts me.
Today I choose what gives me calm.
I listen to myself and I believe myself.
I deserve clarity and respect.
My healing is my priority.
One door closes, another opens.
I am not lost; I am in transition.
I embrace myself in this process.
I rebuild my routine with love.
I pick up hobbies and friendships again.
I go out, breathe, move.

I let out what I feel by writing.

What hurts today is part of my growth.

I teach myself to trust again, calmly.
